raw_translation: Yana amfani da tsari mai kama-da-wani: uku na irin, tsari mai tsarki, tsari, launi, biyu, sa'an nan kuma katin da ya fi girma. A-K-Q yana da matsayi a sama da A-ZXQPH0000QXZ-ZXQPH0001QXZ, wanda aka bi da K-Q-J; wasu tebur na amfani da dokoki daban-daban na gidan. Wannan sigar motsa jiki tana cire dokoki na saka kudi da na kwarewa.
source: Uses a common comparison order: three of a kind, pure sequence, sequence, color, pair, then high card. A-K-Q ranks above A-2-3, followed by K-Q-J; some tables use different house rules. This practice version removes betting and qualification rules.
translation: Yana amfani da tsari mai kama-da-wani: uku na irin, tsari mai tsarki, tsari, launi, biyu, sa'an nan kuma katin da ya fi girma. A-K-Q yana da matsayi a sama da A-2-3, wanda aka bi da K-Q-J; wasu tebur na amfani da dokoki daban-daban na gidan. Wannan sigar motsa jiki tana cire dokoki na saka kudi da na kwarewa.
